h1: 大国掰手腕，小国发大财：谁在中美竞争中坐收渔利？
category: 英国《经济学人》外刊讲解 第1216天
nav_hint: Critical minerals and the US-China rivalry
headline_en: The countries making a fortune from the US-China rivalry | Critical-mineral profits could transform a lucky few
headline_zh: 大国掰手腕，小国发横财——谁在中美对抗中坐收渔利？关键矿产的暴利，或许能彻底改写少数几个幸运儿的命运——但这份"幸运"，只属于寥寥数人。
sources_note: 本文选自 The Economist 2026 年 10 月 29 日文章，由《早安英文》讲解。
practice_intro: 请将以下中文句子翻译为英文（参考答案见后）。

paragraph_overrides.7: Two other big winners are Brazil and Kazakhstan. But they are nevertheless benefiting mightily from American and Chinese interest. America’s approach has been the more focused. In Brazil it has set about building a rare-earth empire. In September USA Rare Earth took over Serra Verde, the only producer of four of the scarcest such minerals outside Asia. A further package pulled together by the Department of War and a loan from the DFC will push American investment to nearly $5bn.
